semiconductor_relevance: High — ATIK Co., Ltd. specializes in advanced instruments and monitoring solutions specifically designed for the semiconductor industry.
summary: ATIK Co., Ltd. provides a range of advanced instruments and services tailored for the semiconductor sector, focusing on process monitoring and control. Their offerings include particle size analyzers and online chemical concentration monitors that enhance process stability and efficiency.
capabilities: Online chemical concentration monitoring for process control
Advanced process monitoring for photolithography and etching

regional_presence.Korea: ATIK Co., Ltd. has been established in Korea since 1994, providing extensive experience and knowledge in the semiconductor field.
